title: Adaptive KV-warmup signatures and onboarding checklist for long-context models
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create an automated onboarding flow and canonical profile format for KV-cache warmup behavior across sequence-length percentiles for new large-context models. Deliverables: (1) telemetry schema that captures per-model KV hit-rate by sequence-length bucket and token-position histogram, (2) a lightweight signature file (KV warmup signature) used by the routing/runtime to decide immediate pin/version behavior and warmup strategy, and (3) a publishing pipeline that writes verified performance profiles to the model catalog so Dedicated/Private customers can pin versions by warmup shape. This ticket covers engineering design, implementation of collection hooks in the runtime, and the publishing API for the console/catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry events emitted for every model variant: sequence_length_bucket, position_histogram (compressed), kv_hit_ratio, latency_p50/95/99 for warm/steady state
Signature JSON schema defined and approved: contains model_id, model_version, warmup_shape_id, recommended_version_pin_strategy (none/warm-first/full), and validity window
Runtime logic can apply signature-driven warmup policy during onboarding without performance regressions in synthetic smoke tests
Publishing pipeline writes profile+signature to model catalog and exposes endpoint /models/{id}/profiles returning latest signatures
Console shows per-model warmup shape and recommended pinning with link to raw profile; e2e test covers a dedicated customer pin scenario
implementation_notes: Collect minimal telemetry at token emission: emit 1 event per request summarizing sequence_length, first_32_positions_kv_hits, total_kv_hits, latency_ms_sampled (p50/p95)
Bucket sequence_length into percentile-aligned bins (0-32,33-128,129-512,513-2048,2049+), compute histograms offline to avoid runtime heavy ops
Signature file uses a compact base64-encoded position bitmap plus scalar kv_hit_ratio per bucket to keep payload < 2KB

Add model onboarding step: when a model is first enabled for serving, runtime queries /profiles; if signature recommends warm-first, runtime pre-populates KV cache with top-K prefixes from sample corpus for X minutes
Version pin metadata: add model_catalog field pin_by_warm_shape: <shape_id> and pin_fallback_policy for compatibility across quantized variants
Publishing pipeline: CI job validates incoming signature against sampling data, signs with service key, and pushes to S3-backed catalog with immutable versioning
Fall-back: if signature missing or stale, use heuristic: favor smaller batch sizes, conservative kv-prefetch thresholds
Metrics: track post-onboard latency delta and cache hit delta for 24h window; alert if latency regresses >10% for P50 or kv_hit_ratio drops >0.15
